key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 何か見えない気配が道をふさいでいる。

key: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
en: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
ja: \PNはシルボンスコープを使った。

key: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
ja: 驚いたポケモンがおそいかかってきた!

key: Many travelers come here to survey Tourmaline Desert before they venture out into it.
en: Many travelers come here to survey Tourmaline Desert before they venture out into it.
ja: 多くの旅人が、トルマリン砂漠に踏み出す前にここで様子を見ていくんだ。

key: Are you the same way?
en: Are you the same way?
ja: 君もそうかい?

key: Then take a good look.
en: Then take a good look.
ja: なら、よく見ておくといい。

key: If you follow the rail north, you'll come up on the Scrapyard.
en: If you follow the rail north, you'll come up on the Scrapyard.
ja: 線路を北にたどっていくと、スクラップヤードに出るよ。

key: Numerous trains have been derailed there and no one has been able to clean them up.
en: Numerous trains have been derailed there and no one has been able to clean them up.
ja: たくさんの列車が脱線したまま、誰も片づけられずにいるんだ。

key: Careful not to go too far north though! Those sandstorms can get mighty fierce, and it's not safe for people to travel in on foot.
en: Careful not to go too far north though! Those sandstorms can get mighty fierce, and it's not safe for people to travel in on foot.
ja: あまり北へ行きすぎないよう気をつけて! あそこの砂嵐はかなり激しくて、歩いて進むのは危険だからね。

key: Further south of that, there's supposed to be a cave buried under the sands somewhere.
en: Further south of that, there's supposed to be a cave buried under the sands somewhere.
ja: そこからさらに南には、砂に埋もれた洞窟があるらしい。

key: In the north-east, I hear other Trainers can see an old tower, but I've never seen it personally.
en: In the north-east, I hear other Trainers can see an old tower, but I've never seen it personally.
ja: 北東には古い塔が見えるって、他のトレーナーから聞くけど、オレ自身は見たことがないんだ。

key: And finally, those mountains in the north-west-- those are the Teknite Mountains!
en: And finally, those mountains in the north-west-- those are the Teknite Mountains!
ja: それから、北西のあの山々――あれがテクナイト山脈さ!

key: I'm fixin' to hike those myself!
en: I'm fixin' to hike those myself!
ja: いつかオレも自分であそこを登るつもりなんだ!

key: Hi. Don't mind me, I'm just people-watching.
en: Hi. Don't mind me, I'm just people-watching.
ja: どうも。気にしないで、ただ人間観察してるだけだから。

key: They run around like everything they do is so important.
en: They run around like everything they do is so important.
ja: みんな、自分のやってることが一大事みたいに走り回ってる。

key: Then again, it's not like I'm any better.
en: Then again, it's not like I'm any better.
ja: まあ、わたしもそう変わらないんだけどね。

key: Always watching, never doing.
en: Always watching, never doing.
ja: いつも見てるだけで、何もしない。

key: Hmm. So they need help at the Coral Gym?
en: Hmm. So they need help at the Coral Gym?
ja: ふうん。コーラルジムで人手がいるの?

key: I guess it's my turn to do something after all.
en: I guess it's my turn to do something after all.
ja: わたしも何かする番みたいね。

key: COREY: The view of the desert is just wonderful, don't you think?
en: COREY: The view of the desert is just wonderful, don't you think?
ja: コーリー：この砂漠の眺めは、実に素晴らしいと思わないか。

key: COREY: It's been a while, \PN.
en: COREY: It's been a while, \PN.
ja: コーリー：久しぶりだな、\PN。

key: Is Heather well? Are you well?
en: Is Heather well? Are you well?
ja: ヘザーは元気か? 君はどうだ?

key: Ah, but this must be very confusing for you.
en: Ah, but this must be very confusing for you.
ja: ああ、しかしこれは君にとって、さぞかし混乱することだろう。

key: Come, enjoy the view with me; I'll explain what's going on.
en: Come, enjoy the view with me; I'll explain what's going on.
ja: さあ、私と一緒にこの景色を楽しみながら、何が起きているのか説明しよう。

key: COREY: I died.
en: COREY: I died.
ja: コーリー：私は死んだ。

key: But Shade ensured a small part of me still remained.
en: But Shade ensured a small part of me still remained.
ja: だが、シェイドのおかげで、私のごくわずかな一部が残された。

key: Not enough to be meaningful, of course, but...
en: Not enough to be meaningful, of course, but...
ja: もちろん、意味を持つほどのものではなかったが……

key: Well, many things that meant nothing began to mean a lot with the creation of the New World.
en: Well, many things that meant nothing began to mean a lot with the creation of the New World.
ja: まあ、ニューワールドが生まれたことで、意味のなかった多くのものが大きな意味を持つようになったのだ。

key: And here I am.
en: And here I am.
ja: そして、私はここにいる。

key: I've been watching you explore the New World, you know.
en: I've been watching you explore the New World, you know.
ja: 君がニューワールドを探検する様子を、ずっと見ていたのだよ。

key: Helping Pokémon, and even helping people.
en: Helping Pokémon, and even helping people.
ja: ポケモンを助け、人々さえも助けているのを。

key: I keep just missing you, though.
en: I keep just missing you, though.
ja: だが、いつも君と入れ違いになってしまってな。

key: I've been trying to track you down, so after all this time...
en: I've been trying to track you down, so after all this time...
ja: 君を探し続けていた。だからこれだけ経って、ようやく……

key: After all this time, I can finally...
en: After all this time, I can finally...
ja: これだけ時が経って、ようやく私は……

key: Apologize.
en: Apologize.
ja: 謝ることができる。

key: COREY: I said some hurtful things to you in my darkest hour.
en: COREY: I said some hurtful things to you in my darkest hour.
ja: コーリー：私が最も暗かったころ、君にひどいことを言ってしまった。

key: Know that you aren't responsible for my actions and choices.
en: Know that you aren't responsible for my actions and choices.
ja: 私の行いや選択の責任は、君にはないと知っておいてほしい。

key: I needed to say that.
en: I needed to say that.
ja: それをどうしても言っておきたかったのだ。

key: COREY: ...So, I hear you met my wife?
en: COREY: ...So, I hear you met my wife?
ja: コーリー：……それで、私の妻に会ったそうだな?

key: Elena, the Skyspectre.
en: Elena, the Skyspectre.
ja: エレナだ。『スカイスペクター』の異名を持つ。

key: She was my world; and the day I lost her, my world ended.
en: She was my world; and the day I lost her, my world ended.
ja: 彼女は私の世界そのものだった。彼女を失った日、私の世界は終わったのだ。

key: But... losing one's own life brings a sense of clarity.
en: But... losing one's own life brings a sense of clarity.
ja: だが……自らの命を失うことで、ある種の澄んだ心持ちが得られるものだ。

key: Even if all I have are memories of her, I'm still the luckiest man to have ever lived.
en: Even if all I have are memories of her, I'm still the luckiest man to have ever lived.
ja: たとえ残されたのが彼女の思い出だけだとしても、私は今までで一番幸運な男だったと言える。

key: She was just unstoppable.
en: She was just unstoppable.
ja: 彼女はまさに、誰にも止められない人だった。

key: Whether it was battling, or just her day to day life, she could do anything she wanted.
en: Whether it was battling, or just her day to day life, she could do anything she wanted.
ja: バトルであれ、日々の暮らしであれ、彼女はやりたいことは何でもできる人だった。

key: She's the reason I love this view.
en: She's the reason I love this view.
ja: 私がこの景色を愛しているのは、彼女がいたからだ。

key: She had a rather macabre sense of humor, you see.
en: She had a rather macabre sense of humor, you see.
ja: 彼女はなかなか不気味なユーモアのセンスを持っていてね。

key: We'd often come out here for dates.
en: We'd often come out here for dates.
ja: よくここへデートに来たものだ。

key: At the mildest inconvenience, she'd jump off the bridge, only to fly back up on her Salamence moments later.
en: At the mildest inconvenience, she'd jump off the bridge, only to fly back up on her Salamence moments later.
ja: ちょっとしたことが気に入らないと、彼女はこの橋から飛び降りて、すぐにボーマンダに乗って舞い戻ってくるのだ。

key: If there were any particularly concerned onlookers, she'd even send up a Ghost Type first just to freak them out.
en: If there were any particularly concerned onlookers, she'd even send up a Ghost Type first just to freak them out.
ja: 心配そうな見物人がいると、まずゴーストタイプを先に飛ばして、脅かしてやることまでしていた。

key: I'm pretty sure that's the entire reason she chose Ghost as her second type.
en: I'm pretty sure that's the entire reason she chose Ghost as her second type.
ja: それこそが、彼女がゴーストをサブタイプに選んだ本当の理由だと、私は確信している。

key: She really was just... perfect.
en: She really was just... perfect.
ja: 彼女は本当に……完璧だった。

key: COREY: I could talk forever about how wonderful she was.
en: COREY: I could talk forever about how wonderful she was.
ja: コーリー：彼女がどれほど素晴らしかったか、いつまでも語っていられる。

key: About how much I miss her.
en: About how much I miss her.
ja: どれほど彼女が恋しいかもな。

key: But I'll have plenty of time to reminisce later.
en: But I'll have plenty of time to reminisce later.
ja: だが、思い出にふけっている時間なら、この先いくらでもある。

key: Elena was so... unfailingly hopeful for the future.
en: Elena was so... unfailingly hopeful for the future.
ja: エレナは……未来に対して、いつも変わらぬ希望を抱いていた。

key: And I think I finally see it.
en: And I think I finally see it.
ja: そして今、私にもようやくそれが見えてきた気がする。

key: Reborn is healing.
en: Reborn is healing.
ja: リボーンは癒えつつある。

key: The people of Reborn are healing.
en: The people of Reborn are healing.
ja: リボーンの人々も癒えつつある。

key: And the region has the finest Champion it ever has.
en: And the region has the finest Champion it ever has.
ja: そしてこの地方には、これまでで最高のチャンピオンがいる。

key: I can't help but wonder, though...
en: I can't help but wonder, though...
ja: だが、どうしても考えてしまうことがある……

key: She was always so certain that I would be the next Champion.
en: She was always so certain that I would be the next Champion.
ja: 彼女はいつも、次のチャンピオンは私だと確信していた。

key: Perhaps I would have been!
en: Perhaps I would have been!
ja: おそらく本当にそうなっていただろう!

key: I was quite talented, you know.
en: I was quite talented, you know.
ja: 私はなかなかの才能の持ち主だったのだよ。

key: At least, I was before she...
en: At least, I was before she...
ja: 少なくとも、彼女が……

key: Well, before I gave up trying.
en: Well, before I gave up trying.
ja: いや、私が挑むのをやめてしまう前は、だな。

key: But I've had time to try again while wandering the New World.
en: But I've had time to try again while wandering the New World.
ja: だが、ニューワールドをさまよう中で、もう一度挑戦する時間はあった。

key: Not very long, of course but...
en: Not very long, of course but...
ja: もちろん、それほど長くはなかったが……

key: Elena always compared me to those child Champions of other regions.
en: Elena always compared me to those child Champions of other regions.
ja: エレナはいつも、私を他の地方の子どものチャンピオンたちと比べていた。

key: The ones who get their first Pokémon and are Champion a week later.
en: The ones who get their first Pokémon and are Champion a week later.
ja: 最初のポケモンをもらって、その一週間後にはチャンピオンになっているような連中とな。

key: With how quickly I picked up battling, she was convinced I could've been that for Reborn if I started a decade or two earlier.
en: With how quickly I picked up battling, she was convinced I could've been that for Reborn if I started a decade or two earlier.
ja: 私がバトルを覚える速さを見て、あと十年か二十年早く始めていれば、リボーンでもそうなれたはずだと彼女は確信していた。

key: But better late than never, right?
en: But better late than never, right?
ja: だが、遅くともやらないよりはましだろう?

key: The future of Reborn is bright with you at the helm, \PN.
en: The future of Reborn is bright with you at the helm, \PN.
ja: \PNがかじを取るリボーンの未来は明るい。

key: But she believed in me so much...
en: But she believed in me so much...
ja: だが、彼女があれほど私を信じてくれていたのだから……

key: It would be a disservice to her to not believe in myself at least as much.
en: It would be a disservice to her to not believe in myself at least as much.
ja: 私自身が同じだけ自分を信じなければ、彼女に対して申し訳が立たない。

key: I think we are long overdue a fight.
en: I think we are long overdue a fight.
ja: そろそろ、私たちは戦うべきだったのだと思う。

key: A fair fight.
en: A fair fight.
ja: 正々堂々とした戦いをな。

key: One where I'm not filled with despair. Or rage. Or murderous intent.
en: One where I'm not filled with despair. Or rage. Or murderous intent.
ja: 絶望にも、怒りにも、殺意にも満たされていない戦いを。

key: One where I try...
en: One where I try...
ja: 私が全力を尽くす戦いを……

key: Where I remember the love for battle I had forgotten.
en: Where I remember the love for battle I had forgotten.
ja: 忘れていたバトルへの愛を、思い出せる戦いを。

key: So bring it on, Champion \PN.
en: So bring it on, Champion \PN.
ja: さあ、かかってこい、チャンピオン\PN。

key: Let's see if you would've been able to take the title from me if I had've gotten it first!
en: Let's see if you would've been able to take the title from me if I had've gotten it first!
ja: もし私が先にその称号を手にしていたら、君はそれを私から奪えていたか、見てみようじゃないか!

key: Give me another week, I'll battle circles around you!
en: Give me another week, I'll battle circles around you!
ja: あと一週間　くれれば　きみを　手玉に取ってみせるよ

key: COREY: Brilliant!
en: COREY: Brilliant!
ja: コーリー：見事だ!

key: But don't get comfortable.
en: But don't get comfortable.
ja: だが、油断はするなよ。

key: By the time I have all the badges to challenge you officially, I'll be at least twice as good!
en: By the time I have all the badges to challenge you officially, I'll be at least twice as good!
ja: 正式に君に挑めるだけのバッジをそろえる頃には、私は少なくとも今の倍は強くなっているはずだ!

key: COREY: Wait, no, I...
en: COREY: Wait, no, I...
ja: コーリー：待て、いや、私は……

key: What's happening?
en: What's happening?
ja: 何が起きている?

key: I don't want to go back to--
en: I don't want to go back to--
ja: 戻りたくない、あんなところには……

key: COREY: \PN.
en: COREY: \PN.
ja: コーリー：\PN。

key: When did you get here?
en: When did you get here?
ja: いつここに来た?

key: Did you come to kill me again?
en: Did you come to kill me again?
ja: また私を殺しに来たのか?

key: Did you want a repeat show?
en: Did you want a repeat show?
ja: もう一度、同じ見世物が見たいのか?

key: Take another swing at poisoning my daughter's mind against me?
en: Take another swing at poisoning my daughter's mind against me?
ja: また娘の心に毒を吹き込んで、私に背かせるつもりか?

key: Or perhaps you just wanted to show up and make a terrorist group get desperate and sloppy again?
en: Or perhaps you just wanted to show up and make a terrorist group get desperate and sloppy again?
ja: それとも、ただ現れてテロ組織をまた追い詰めて、やけを起こさせたかっただけか?

key: COREY: Things were more dangerous for everyone because of you.
en: COREY: Things were more dangerous for everyone because of you.
ja: コーリー：お前のせいで、誰にとってもすべてがより危険になった。

key: Everything you touch turns toxic.
en: Everything you touch turns toxic.
ja: お前が触れるものすべてが、毒に変わっていく。

key: Truly, a fitting Champion for this region.
en: Truly, a fitting Champion for this region.
ja: まさに、この地方にふさわしいチャンピオンだ。

key: COREY: Ace. Solaris. Me.
en: COREY: Ace. Solaris. Me.
ja: コーリー：エース。ソラリス。そして私。

key: People died because Meteor got desperate.
en: People died because Meteor got desperate.
ja: メテオが追い詰められ、必死になったせいで人々が死んだ。

key: Animals are most dangerous when they're cornered.
en: Animals are most dangerous when they're cornered.
ja: 動物は追い詰められたときが、もっとも危険なのだ。

key: Make no mistake, their deaths-- and the countless others Meteor caused-- are your fault.
en: Make no mistake, their deaths-- and the countless others Meteor caused-- are your fault.
ja: 間違えるな、彼らの死は――そしてメテオが引き起こした数えきれない他の死も――すべてお前のせいだ。

key: And you could traipse through the New World and find every single one of them, if you wanted.
en: And you could traipse through the New World and find every single one of them, if you wanted.
ja: その気になれば、ニューワールドを歩き回って、その一人一人を見つけ出すこともできるだろう。

key: But nothing would change.
en: But nothing would change.
ja: だが、何も変わりはしない。

key: Their blood will always be on your hands.
en: Their blood will always be on your hands.
ja: 彼らの血は、いつまでもお前の手についたままだ。

key: I am naught but poison to those around me.
en: I am naught but poison to those around me.
ja: 私は、周りの者にとってただの毒でしかない。

key: But you are poison to everything.
en: But you are poison to everything.
ja: だが、お前はあらゆるものにとっての毒だ。

key: And I will make sure you never have the satisfaction of saving everyone.
en: And I will make sure you never have the satisfaction of saving everyone.
ja: そして、お前に全員を救ったという満足感だけは、絶対に味わわせない。

key: You'll never get to pat yourself on the back for that.
en: You'll never get to pat yourself on the back for that.
ja: それで自分を誇ることなど、決して許さない。

key: COREY: Because one will still always be gone.
en: COREY: Because one will still always be gone.
ja: コーリー：なぜなら、いつだって誰か一人は失われたままだからだ。

key: And it will always be your fault.
en: And it will always be your fault.
ja: そして、それはいつでもお前のせいだ。

key: COREY: Elena, my darling...
en: COREY: Elena, my darling...
ja: コーリー：エレナ、愛しい人……

key: I came here every day...
en: I came here every day...
ja: 私は毎日ここに来た……

key: Hoping I'd see you fly up on that Salamence once more...
en: Hoping I'd see you fly up on that Salamence once more...
ja: もう一度、あのボーマンダに乗って舞い上がる君を見られることを願って……

key: But I know you can't come back to me.
en: But I know you can't come back to me.
ja: だが、君が私のもとへ戻ってこられないことはわかっている。

key: But perhaps... I can come back to you...?
en: But perhaps... I can come back to you...?
ja: だが、もしかしたら……私が君のもとへ戻ることはできるだろうか……?

key: I wanted to go chasing the horizon with you one more time...
en: I wanted to go chasing the horizon with you one more time...
ja: もう一度、君と一緒に地平線を追いかけたかった……

key: Fly a little faster, darling...
en: Fly a little faster, darling...
ja: もう少し速く飛んでくれ、愛しい人……

key: Just a little more, and I'd swear we could reach out and touch the moon.
en: Just a little more, and I'd swear we could reach out and touch the moon.
ja: あと少しで、月にだって手が届きそうな気がしたんだ。
